---
title: Which package do I need?
description: The four NimbleBrain packages — nimblebrain-server-sdk, nimblebrain-synapse, @nimblebrain/synapse and @nimblebrain/sdk — what each is for, and the supported pairing for an app.
---

Four packages, two registries. Which you need depends on what you are building.

| Package | Registry | Language | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`nimblebrain-server-sdk`](https://pypi.org/project/nimblebrain-server-sdk/) | PyPI | Python | **The server.** Tool annotations, change announcements, the `ai.nimblebrain` extensions, skills and the error contract, with database access, observability and notifications as extras. [Docs](/server-sdk/quickstart/) |
| [`nimblebrain-synapse`](https://pypi.org/project/nimblebrain-synapse/) | PyPI | Python | **Serving an app's interface.** One `ui://` component declared in the server and rendered in any MCP Apps host. [Docs](https://synapse.nimblebrain.ai/docs/quickstart-python/) |
| [`@nimblebrain/synapse`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nimblebrain/synapse) | npm | TypeScript | **Writing that interface.** The part that runs in the browser: calling tools, staying in sync with the agent, theming. [Docs](https://synapse.nimblebrain.ai/docs/quickstart-react/) |
| [`@nimblebrain/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nimblebrain/sdk) | npm | TypeScript | **The API client.** A program that calls NimbleBrain's API from outside. Not used to build a server. |

## By what you are building

| You are building | Install |
|---|---|
| A connector: a server alone | `nimblebrain-server-sdk` |
| An app: a server plus its interface | `nimblebrain-server-sdk` and `nimblebrain-synapse` in the server; `@nimblebrain/synapse` in the interface |
| A program that calls NimbleBrain | `@nimblebrain/sdk` |
| A server in another language | None. Implement the protocol from the "Wire (any SDK)" tabs, starting at [MCP extensions](/extensions/overview/) |

## The supported pairing for an app

An app's server uses the Server SDK and Synapse together, on one FastMCP server:

```bash
uv add nimblebrain-server-sdk 'nimblebrain-synapse[fastmcp]'
```

| | Version |
|---|---|
| `nimblebrain-server-sdk` | 0.7 or later |
| `nimblebrain-synapse` | 0.10 or later, with its `fastmcp` extra |
| FastMCP | 4.0 or later |
| Python | 3.13 or later |

On a FastMCP server the interface is a `FastMCPSynapseUI`, from `nimblebrain_synapse.fastmcp`, registered with `mcp.add_extension(ui)`. `SynapseUI` is the class for a server built on the `mcp` SDK's `MCPServer`. Synapse's [Python quickstart](https://synapse.nimblebrain.ai/docs/quickstart-python/) shows both.

The Server SDK requires FastMCP 4, and `nimblebrain-synapse` supports FastMCP from 0.10, so an earlier Synapse release cannot be paired with it.

The two do different jobs and do not overlap: the Server SDK is what the server shares with NimbleBrain's host, and Synapse is what the server shares with its own interface, on any host.
